title: Warhost joins the CSAF Godot Collection: now 23 addon packs
html:
Warhost is now part of the CSAF Godot Collection, version 1.2.0. If you own the collection, the new file is on your download page now, at no extra cost. It holds all 23 of our paid Godot 4.7 addon packs in one project, 1,223 presets for 2D games.

What joined

Warhost: army battles soldier by soldier under generated banners, 48 staged battles. 48 presets. Its addon folder in the collection is the same files as its own download, and its demo opens from the browser like every other pack.

Also in this version

  • The browser now shows 23 cards in three rows of 8.

Every preset of all 23 packs was photographed again under Forward+ and Compatibility on the shipped bytes, 2,448 frames, with no engine error line.

The CSAF Godot Collection is $19.99. Warhost alone is $14.99.

Made with AI tools: the code was written with AI, and the demo art comes from our own generated sets.
